findings.title: Container connects to localhost for a Service in another pod
findings.cause: container worker exits because its connection to 127.0.0.1:6379 is refused: in a pod, localhost is the pod itself, and none of its containers listens on 6379. What serves that port here is Service cache, in other pods; its log says: "wget: can't connect to remote host (127.0.0.1): Connection refused"; Deployment worker has 0 of 1 replicas ready

evidence.what: container worker exited with code 1 (Error), restarted 5 times
last lines of container worker's log (run that exited)
evidence.detail:
Connecting to 127.0.0.1:6379 (127.0.0.1:6379)
wget: can't connect to remote host (127.0.0.1): Connection refused

evidence.what: no container of pod worker-59b4bbb7cd-8ffwg declares port 6379
evidence.command: kubectl get pod worker-59b4bbb7cd-8ffwg -n kd-localhost-for-service -o jsonpath='{range .spec.containers[*]}{.name}{" "}{.ports[*].containerPort}{"\n"}{end}'

evidence.what: Service cache serves port 6379 from other pods (selector app=cache)
evidence.command: kubectl get service cache -n kd-localhost-for-service -o jsonpath='{.spec.selector}{" "}{.spec.ports}'

findings.fix: Connect to cache:6379 instead of 127.0.0.1:6379: set it in env CACHE_URL (now http://127.0.0.1:6379/).
